scope: Local macOS arm64 private direct-Chrome network controls. No Connect gateway, provider operation, frozen-profile qualification or production change.
status: Three controlled diagnostics completed; strict clean positive passed; original nonclean overall verdicts remain failed.
question: Does sustained sparse encoding depend on configured random loss or added random delay/reordering when the source, SDK transform and sender settings remain fixed?
finding: Added random delay/reordering without any recorded proxy loss produced sparse encoding and failed coded AV in this run; random3%loss without added delay did not. The clean positive control passed.

controls.profile_difference: The frozen qualification combines3%loss,0–100msdelay and two250msstalls. These diagnostics intentionally omit stalls and separate loss from delay; they cannot qualify that combined profile.
controls.clean_positive_gate: The later cases execute only after original clean status passed with childexit0 and valid controls: at least24 decoded and changing frames per second, coded AV, audio, identity, motion, worker, codec, dimensions and teardown requirements.
controls.fixed_media: Same generated coded-content source, receivers and observers; VP8 primary plus matching RTX,640×360/30fps capture, maintain-resolution, maximum1Mbps/30fps sender. Required production worker and keyframe policy retained.
controls.network: One owned loopback bidirectional UDP proxy in every arm; exact configured treatment and zero unexpected drop causes verified. Selected remote proxy paths sampled throughout both peer windows.

controller_observation: Clean and loss-only traces have zero delay OVERUSING events and final delay estimates1.9–2.4Mbps. Both jitter-only traces have12 OVERUSING events, minimum84,400bps, and final delay estimates170,550/129,631bps. This observes a delay-controller response under the isolated treatment, not proof of an implementation defect or its exact internal cause.
motion_guard_caveat: The unchanged motionObservation impairment mode requires at least one burst. Both nonclean arms intentionally provide none, so their original motion verdicts and overall media verdicts remain failed with empty active_segments. Raw changing-frame observations, coded-AV verdicts, encoder counters and network/path controls remain independently reported; this analysis does not override original verdicts or claim a no-burst qualification pass.
causal_limits: One sample per network treatment; not a statistical equivalence claim or proof3%loss always preserves cadence. Different traffic means different packet realizations.
No bursts in any arm; these diagnostics intentionally differ from the frozen combined loss/jitter/stall profile.

No recorded proxy drops does not prove every dispatched packet was authenticated or decoded. Reordering can induce provisional missing reports, late rejection or retransmission without proxy random loss.

Zero added delay means proxy scheduling delay0; actual maximum receipt-to-sendto-return scheduling remained3–6ms on clean/loss-only. Jitter observed maxima101.7/102.4ms include event-loop scheduling, despite maximum planned delay at most100ms.
LossBasedBweUpdates is capped combined target, not raw loss estimator. Continuous acknowledged throughput, exact limiter cause and encoder drop reasons remain unobserved.
No changes to required production transform, keyframe policy, cadence thresholds, congestion control or frozen qualification are justified solely by this diagnostic.
mapping: Local sender index feeds opposite receiver index. Controller log rows retain their original file identity in the private comparison; no unsupported log-to-peer mapping is asserted here.
independent_review: Accepted bounded diagnostic interpretation;138 runtime inputs,20 analysis inputs and all retained case/log/event references verified.
